subject: mathematics
content: Let $$\lambda_{1}, \lambda_{2}$$ be the values of $$\lambda$$ for which the points $$\left(\frac{5}{2}, 1, \lambda\right)$$ and $$(-2,0,1)$$ are at equal distance from the plane $$2 x+3 y-6 z+7=0$$. If $$\lambda_{1} > \lambda_{2}$$, then the distance of the point $$\left(\lambda_{1}-\lambda_{2}, \lambda_{2}, \lambda_{1}\right)$$ from the line $$\frac{x-5}{1}=\frac{y-1}{2}=\frac{z+7}{2}$$ is ____________.
